title: Chunking Strategy and Experiments
boundaries: Day95 active-version and exact source/parsed-artifact bindings are prerequisites; Day96 does not recreate document truth.
Canonical source offsets refer to Day95 parsed text, not original uploaded byte offsets.
The classroom tokenizer does not establish any embedding model token count.
The in-process store models atomic selection plus outbox intent but does not prove distributed durability, multi-process fencing, or crash recovery.
Structural comparison on one synthetic corpus does not prove general retrieval quality or answer quality.
Same-tenant visibility is principal- and ACL-dependent; Day97 must enforce authorization and evaluation labels must respect authorized source evidence.
not_run: real tokenizer offline and concurrent execution checks
distributed transactional chunk store and multi-process fencing
real outbox dispatcher and duplicate-delivery recovery
production telemetry backend and alert delivery
load, soak, memory RSS, and CPU measurement
embedding, index, retrieval, citations, and answer evaluation

retained_corrections: Day95 activation is not authorization for every principal
selected pointer is necessary but not sufficient; its version must match Day95 current active version
overlap preserves nearby context but cannot repair a source-coverage gap
re-ingestion follows changed source or parser contract; re-chunking does not create a new ParsedArtifact
oversized atomic units may fail closed or use an explicit bounded fallback
a strategy with incomplete coverage is rejected before ranking
structural metrics do not establish Recall@k or Precision@k
